title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for .claude-plugin/plugin.json — a Claude Code plugin manifest. Anthropic does not publish a standalone machine-readable schema, so this is derived from the Claude Code plugins reference (https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/plugins — plugin.json fields) as of 2026-07-22. A Claude Code release adding new manifest fields requires re-vendoring.

name.description: Plugin identifier: lowercase kebab-case, no spaces.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

commands.description: Extra command file or directory paths beyond the default commands/ directory.

agents.description: Extra agent file or directory paths beyond the default agents/ directory.

skills.description: Extra skill directory paths beyond the default skills/ directory.

hooks.description: Hooks config path (string) or inline hooks configuration.

mcpServers.description: MCP config path (string) or inline MCP server definitions.

lspServers.description: Language Server Protocol configs for code intelligence: path to .lsp.json (string), or inline server map/array.
